BUILT FOR THE BREAK · V1.0
ASTRA / FLIGHT MANUAL

A little control.
A lot of possibility.

Break every brick to advance through five sectors. Your real destination? The space above them.

Move in two dimensions.

Move your pointer or use arrow keys / WASD. Your paddle can travel left, right, up, and down in the lower quarter of the field.

Put some energy into it.

Move upward as the ball hits your paddle to give it a boost. Where it lands on your paddle changes its direction.

Made for your thumbs.

Choose Thumb mode. Touch the field and drag to create a floating thumbstick. Push up to boost. Lift your finger to stop.

Not all bricks play by the same rules.

Classic: One good hit is all it takes.

/Prism: Match the slash direction, at least 20° from vertical.

»Velocity: Reach 740+ speed. Boost upward into the ball first.

Then things get interesting.

Get above the bricks to enter overdrive and grow your multiplier: plasma piercing, then multiball, then electric chain reactions. Catch falling power-ups for more boosts and extra lives. Keep at least one ball in play to save a life.

SPACE pause / resume · ESC close

Ready to play. Five sectors. Three lives.
